adversarialSuite.name: Expedition Targeting & Next-Pairing Rotation Integrity
adversarialSuite.finding: VERIFIED FIXED: Scheduled matchup (Gutter-Crown Mercenaries vs Matron Brine-Bog), Trade Floor selection, Live Canvas preview, and simulateRegionExpedition() resolution (Gutter-Crown Mercenaries vs Matron Brine-Bog) match 100%, with next rotation (Novices of St. Jude vs Alderman Vance (Disgraced)) clearly exposed.

adversarialSuite.name: Crafted-Item Fidelity & Canonical Composition Identity
adversarialSuite.finding: VERIFIED FIXED: Distinct formulations sharing identical display names retain distinct canonical IDs (prod_alc_1fbd18ad vs prod_chicken_morph; prod_trp_15eda973 vs prod_trap_plate_spikes) and preserve 100% of their assay properties through inventory, sale, and expedition simulation (8kg variant caught 19kg morphed hero).
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Modify components of Bantam Chicken-Morph Draught or 45kg Pressure-Plate Spike Battery while keeping the same name -> brew/assemble -> verify both variants coexist with distinct canonical IDs and stats.

adversarialSuite.name: Expert Progression Gate & Cryptographic Catalyst Provenance
adversarialSuite.finding: VERIFIED FIXED: customBrewsCount & customTrapsCount initialize at 0; Solo & Peer Catalyst routes require Blackspire (Hard) unlocked; forged hash CATALYST-FAKE-D1-ABCDEF12 rejected ("Provenance Signature Mismatch: Hash #ABCDEF12 failed cryptographic verification for sender FAKE (Day 1)."); duplicate replay rejected.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Attempt Solo or Peer Catalyst unlock before Blackspire (Hard) or with forged hash suffix -> rejected.

adversarialSuite.name: General Mass/Threshold Physics vs Hardcoded Item Name Check
adversarialSuite.finding: PROVEN GENERAL RULE: Synthesized "Generic Grav-Light Draught" (prod_alc_b972fb2a, massEffectKg=-85kg) bypassed the 45kg Pressure Plate (effective mass 12kg < 45kg) via general trait summation.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Synthesize [reg_base_06, reg_act_11, reg_car_02, reg_stb_02, reg_cat_01] -> equip on 84kg Vanguard vs 45kg plate.

adversarialSuite.name: General Stoichiometric Sulphur Sensitivity vs Hardcoded Story Exception
adversarialSuite.finding: PROVEN GENERAL RULE: netSulphurSens > 25 && !filtersSulphur governs degradation across all reagent combinations.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Compare unbuffered vs chelated custom stone-cures in Sulphur Fog.

adversarialSuite.name: Seed + Action Log + Product ID Byte-Identical Determinism Audit
adversarialSuite.finding: VERIFIED FIXED: Both 120-day campaign execution AND synthesizeAlchemyProduct/assembleTrapProduct canonical IDs (prod_alc_10dc5e3b === prod_alc_10dc5e3b) are 100% deterministic with zero Date.now() or Math.random() calls.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Call synthesizeAlchemyProduct() twice with identical arguments; verify returned product.id and formulaSignature are byte-identical.

adversarialSuite.name: Zero-Bailout Debt Capitalization & Consumable Loadout Depletion
adversarialSuite.finding: VERIFIED FIXED: The silent 120g cash floor is removed (any negative cash is capitalized into debt), Bridge Loan interest is 0.5%/day with 25% profit auto-amortization, and expedition consumables deplete across delves. Both Dungeon Loyalist (+85544g) and Hero Benefactor (+52267g) are solvent with 0 bailout days.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Run 120-day campaigns across all 5 strategies without the 120g floor -> verify positive net worth and zero artificial bailouts.

adversarialSuite.name: Secret Provenance Fee (-35g) Floor Clamp Protection
adversarialSuite.finding: unitPrice is clamped via Math.max(25, Math.round(product.suggestedPrice * priceMultiplier) - (secretProvenance ? 35 : 0)), preventing negative-price contracts.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Select lowest-price product at 85% discount with Secret Provenance (-35g) enabled -> unitPrice clamps at >=25g.
